# apps/web/src/api-status.tsx · 6 stacks
#   solid-spa-hono-ui-sdk-bun-docker
#   solid-spa-hono-ui-sdk-bun-docker-e2e
#   solid-spa-hono-ui-sdk-docker
#   solid-spa-hono-ui-sdk-docker-e2e
#   solid-spa-hono-ui-sdk-workers
#   solid-spa-hono-ui-sdk-workers-e2e
import { createMemo } from "solid-js";

const checkHealth = async () => {
  try {
    const response = await fetch("/api/health");

    return response.ok ? "API connected" : "API unreachable";
  } catch {
    return "API unreachable";
  }
};

export const ApiStatus = () => {
  const status = createMemo(checkHealth);

  return <output>{status()}</output>;
};

import { MotionConfig, motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

import { cn } from "@my-app/ui/lib/utils";

import { DotGrid } from "#src/components/dot-grid.tsx";
import { StackPlate } from "#src/components/stack-plate.tsx";

interface Layer {
  readonly name: string;
  readonly role: string;
}

const assemble = {
  hidden: {},
  shown: { transition: { delayChildren: 0.1, staggerChildren: 0.08 } },
};

const drop = {
  hidden: { opacity: 0, y: -48 },
  shown: { opacity: 1, y: 0 },
};

const walkInterval = 550;

/** Calls `onStep` for each layer in turn, ending back on the first, and returns what stops it early. */
const walkLayers = (count: number, onStep: (index: number) => void) => {
  let step = 0;

  const timer = setInterval(() => {
    step += 1;
    onStep(step % count);

    if (step === count) {
      clearInterval(timer);
    }
  }, walkInterval);

  return () => {
    clearInterval(timer);
  };
};

/**
 * Each plate overlaps the one below it, and later elements paint on top, so the DOM runs bottom to top and
 * `flex-col-reverse` puts the first layer back on top.
 */
export const StackDiagram = ({ layers }: { layers: readonly Layer[] }) => {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion();
  const [hovered, setHovered] = useState(false);

  const [active, setActive] = useState(0);
  const walking = reduced !== true && !hovered;

  // A request travels down the stack once on load; pointing at a layer takes over from it.
  useEffect(
    () => (walking ? walkLayers(layers.length, setActive) : undefined),
    [layers.length, walking]
  );

  return (
    <MotionConfig
      reducedMotion="user"
      transition={{ bounce: 0.25, duration: 0.6, type: "spring" }}
    >
      <div className="relative isolate">
        <DotGrid />
        <motion.ul
          animate="shown"
          aria-label="The stack"
          className="flex flex-col-reverse pt-14 pb-14"
          initial="hidden"
          onPointerEnter={() => {
            setHovered(true);
          }}
          variants={assemble}
        >
          {layers
            .map((layer, index) => ({ index, layer }))
            .toReversed()
            .map(({ index, layer: { name, role } }) => (
              <li
                className="relative flex h-13 items-center pl-44 sm:pl-64"
                key={role}
                onPointerEnter={() => {
                  setActive(index);
                }}
              >
                <motion.div
                  className="absolute top-1/2 left-0 w-36 -translate-y-[44%] sm:w-52"
                  variants={drop}
                >
                  {/* The layers above the active one lift to reveal it. */}
                  <motion.div animate={{ y: index < active ? -20 : 0 }}>
                    <StackPlate active={index === active} />
                  </motion.div>
                </motion.div>
                <span
                  aria-hidden="true"
                  className={cn(
                    "absolute top-1/2 left-36 h-px w-6 transition-colors duration-300 sm:left-52 sm:w-10",
                    index === active ? "bg-primary" : "bg-border"
                  )}
                />
                <div className="flex flex-col">
                  <span className="text-muted-foreground text-xs">{role}</span>
                  <span
                    className={cn(
                      "font-medium transition-colors duration-300",
                      index !== active && "text-muted-foreground"
                    )}
                  >
                    {name}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </li>
            ))}
        </motion.ul>
      </div>
    </MotionConfig>
  );
};

      <polygon className={side} points="100,100 200,50 200,64 100,114" />
      <polygon
        className={cn(
          "transition-colors duration-300",
          active
            ? "fill-primary stroke-primary"
            : "fill-card stroke-foreground/25"
        )}
        points="100,0 200,50 100,100 0,50"
      />
    </svg>
  );
};

import { ThemeMenu } from "@my-app/ui/components/theme-menu";
import "@my-app/ui/globals.css";

import { Router } from "#src/router.tsx";

const App = () => (
  <Router>
    {(route) => (
      <>
        <header class="flex justify-between border-b p-4">
          <nav class="flex gap-4">
            <a href={Router.paths()}>Home</a>
            <a href={Router.paths.about()}>About</a>
          </nav>
          <ThemeMenu />
        </header>
        {route.children}
      </>
    )}
  </Router>
);

const root = document.querySelector("#root");

if (!root) {
  throw new Error("Missing #root element");
}

render(App, root);

import "@my-app/ui/globals.css";
import { RouterProvider } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { StrictMode } from "react";
import { createRoot } from "react-dom/client";

import { createAppRouter } from "#src/router.tsx";

const router = createAppRouter();
const container = document.querySelector("#root");

if (!container) {
  throw new Error("Missing #root element");
}

createRoot(container).render(
  <StrictMode>
    <RouterProvider router={router} />
  </StrictMode>
);

import { QueryClientProvider } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { createRouter } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import type { RouterHistory } from "@tanstack/react-router";

import { Loader } from "#src/components/loader.tsx";
import { createQueryClient } from "#src/lib/query-client.ts";
import { routeTree } from "#src/routeTree.gen.ts";

export const createAppRouter = (history?: RouterHistory) => {
  const queryClient = createQueryClient();

  return createRouter({
    routeTree,
    history,
    context: { queryClient },
    defaultPreload: "intent",
    defaultPreloadStaleTime: 0,
    defaultPendingComponent: Loader,
    scrollRestoration: true,
    Wrap: ({ children }) => (
      <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>{children}</QueryClientProvider>
    ),
  });
};

declare module "@tanstack/react-router" {
  interface Register {
    router: ReturnType<typeof createAppRouter>;
  }
}

import { RegistryProvider } from "@effect/atom-react";

import { Loader } from "#src/components/loader.tsx";
import { routeTree } from "#src/routeTree.gen.ts";

  createRouter({
    routeTree,
    history,
    defaultPreload: "intent",
    defaultPreloadStaleTime: 0,
    defaultPendingComponent: Loader,
    scrollRestoration: true,
    Wrap: ({ children }) => <RegistryProvider>{children}</RegistryProvider>,
  });

import { RegistryProvider } from "@effect/atom-react";
import { createRouter } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import type { RouterHistory } from "@tanstack/react-router";

import { Loader } from "#src/components/loader.tsx";
import { routeTree } from "#src/routeTree.gen.ts";

export const createAppRouter = (history?: RouterHistory) =>
  createRouter({
    routeTree,
    history,
    context: { session: null },
    defaultPreload: "intent",
    defaultPreloadStaleTime: 0,
    defaultPendingComponent: Loader,
    scrollRestoration: true,
    Wrap: ({ children }) => <RegistryProvider>{children}</RegistryProvider>,
  });

declare module "@tanstack/react-router" {
  interface Register {
    router: ReturnType<typeof createAppRouter>;
  }
}

import type { QueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { ReactQueryDevtools } from "@tanstack/react-query-devtools";
import {
  HeadContent,
  Outlet,
  createRootRouteWithContext,
} from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { TanStackRouterDevtools } from "@tanstack/react-router-devtools";
import { ThemeProvider } from "next-themes";

import { Toaster } from "@my-app/ui/components/sonner";

import { Header } from "#src/components/header.tsx";

interface RouterContext {
  queryClient: QueryClient;
}

const RootLayout = () => (
  <ThemeProvider
    attribute="class"
    defaultTheme="system"
    disableTransitionOnChange
    scriptProps={{ type: "application/json" }}
  >
    <HeadContent />
    <div className="grid min-h-svh grid-rows-[auto_1fr]">
      <Header />
      <main className="mx-auto w-full max-w-5xl px-5 py-10 sm:px-8 sm:py-14">
        <Outlet />
      </main>
    </div>
    <Toaster richColors />
    <TanStackRouterDevtools position="bottom-left" />

  </ThemeProvider>
);

export const Route = createRootRouteWithContext<RouterContext>()({
  head: () => ({
    meta: [{ title: "my-app" }],
  }),
  component: RootLayout,
});

import {
  HeadContent,
  Outlet,
  createRootRouteWithContext,
  useRouter,
} from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { TanStackRouterDevtools } from "@tanstack/react-router-devtools";
import { ThemeProvider } from "next-themes";
import { useEffect } from "react";

import { Toaster } from "@my-app/ui/components/sonner";

import { Header } from "#src/components/header.tsx";
import { authClient, getSession } from "#src/lib/auth.ts";
import type { Session } from "#src/lib/auth.ts";

interface RouterContext {
  session: Session | null;
}

const RootLayout = () => {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { session } = Route.useRouteContext();
  const current = authClient.useSession();
  const sessionId = current.data?.session.id;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (
      !current.isPending &&
      !current.error &&
      sessionId !== session?.session.id
    ) {
      void router.invalidate();
    }
  }, [
    current.isPending,
    current.error,
    sessionId,
    session?.session.id,
    router,
  ]);

  return (
    <ThemeProvider
      attribute="class"
      defaultTheme="system"
      disableTransitionOnChange
      scriptProps={{ type: "application/json" }}
    >
      <HeadContent />
      <div className="grid min-h-svh grid-rows-[auto_1fr]">
        <Header />
        <main className="mx-auto w-full max-w-5xl px-5 py-10 sm:px-8 sm:py-14">
          <Outlet />
        </main>
      </div>
      <Toaster richColors />
      <TanStackRouterDevtools position="bottom-left" />
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
};

export const Route = createRootRouteWithContext<RouterContext>()({
  beforeLoad: async () => ({ session: await getSession() }),
  head: () => ({
    meta: [{ title: "my-app" }],
  }),
  component: RootLayout,
});

import type { QueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { ReactQueryDevtools } from "@tanstack/react-query-devtools";
import {
  HeadContent,
  Outlet,
  createRootRouteWithContext,
} from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { TanStackRouterDevtools } from "@tanstack/react-router-devtools";
import { ThemeProvider } from "next-themes";

import { Toaster } from "@my-app/ui/components/sonner";

import { Header } from "#src/components/header.tsx";
import { getSession } from "#src/lib/auth.ts";

interface RouterContext {
  queryClient: QueryClient;
}

const RootLayout = () => (
  <ThemeProvider
    attribute="class"
    defaultTheme="system"
    disableTransitionOnChange
    scriptProps={{ type: "application/json" }}
  >
    <HeadContent />
    <div className="grid min-h-svh grid-rows-[auto_1fr]">
      <Header />
      <main className="mx-auto w-full max-w-5xl px-5 py-10 sm:px-8 sm:py-14">
        <Outlet />
      </main>
    </div>
    <Toaster richColors />
    <TanStackRouterDevtools position="bottom-left" />
    <ReactQueryDevtools buttonPosition="bottom-right" />
  </ThemeProvider>
);

export const Route = createRootRouteWithContext<RouterContext>()({
  beforeLoad: async () => ({ session: await getSession() }),
  head: () => ({
    meta: [{ title: "my-app" }],
  }),
  component: RootLayout,
});

import {
  useMutation,
  useQueryClient,
  useSuspenseQuery,
} from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { createFileRoute } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { ListTodoIcon, PlusIcon, Trash2Icon } from "lucide-react";
import {
  AnimatePresence,
  MotionConfig,
  motion,
  useReducedMotion,
} from "motion/react";
import { useState } from "react";
import type { SubmitEvent } from "react";

import { Badge } from "@my-app/ui/components/badge";
import { Button } from "@my-app/ui/components/button";
import { Card, CardContent } from "@my-app/ui/components/card";
import { Checkbox } from "@my-app/ui/components/checkbox";
import {
  Empty,
  EmptyDescription,
  EmptyHeader,
  EmptyMedia,
  EmptyTitle,
} from "@my-app/ui/components/empty";
import { Input } from "@my-app/ui/components/input";
import { Separator } from "@my-app/ui/components/separator";
import { Spinner } from "@my-app/ui/components/spinner";
import { cn } from "@my-app/ui/lib/utils";

import { useHydrated } from "#src/hooks/use-hydrated.ts";
import { api } from "#src/lib/api.ts";

const TodosPage = () => {
  const hydrated = useHydrated();
  const reduced = useReducedMotion() === true;
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState({ title: "" });
  const { title } = draft;
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const { data: todos } = useSuspenseQuery(api.todos.list.queryOptions());

  const invalidateTodos = {
    onSuccess: async () => {
      await queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: api.todos.key() });
    },
  };

  const createTodo = useMutation(
    api.todos.create.mutationOptions(invalidateTodos)
  );

  const updateTodo = useMutation(
    api.todos.update.mutationOptions(invalidateTodos)
  );

  const deleteTodo = useMutation(
    api.todos.delete.mutationOptions(invalidateTodos)
  );

  const done = todos.filter((todo) => todo.completed).length;

  const handleSubmit = (event: SubmitEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    createTodo.mutate(
      { title },
      {
        onSuccess: () => {
          // Keep whatever was typed while the request was in flight.
          setDraft((current) => (current === draft ? { title: "" } : current));
        },
      }
    );
  };

  return (
    <MotionConfig reducedMotion="user">
      <section className="mx-auto flex w-full max-w-2xl flex-col gap-8">
        <header className="flex flex-wrap items-end justify-between gap-4">
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
            <h1 className="text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight">Todos</h1>
            <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm">
              Shared by everyone who opens the app.
            </p>
          </div>
          {todos.length > 0 && (
            <Badge variant="secondary">
              {done} of {todos.length} done
            </Badge>
          )}
        </header>
        {todos.length > 0 && (
          <div className="bg-muted h-1 overflow-hidden rounded-full">
            <motion.div
              animate={{ scaleX: done / todos.length }}
              className="bg-primary h-full origin-left"
              initial={false}
              transition={{ bounce: 0, duration: 0.5, type: "spring" }}
            />
          </div>
        )}
        <Card>
          <CardContent>
            <form className="flex gap-2" onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
              <Input
                aria-label="New todo"
                disabled={!hydrated}
                maxLength={200}
                onChange={(event) => {
                  setDraft({ title: event.target.value });
                }}
                placeholder="Add a todo"
                value={title}
              />
              <Button
                disabled={
                  !hydrated || createTodo.isPending || title.trim() === ""
                }
                type="submit"
              >
                {createTodo.isPending ? (
                  <Spinner data-icon="inline-start" />
                ) : (
                  <PlusIcon data-icon="inline-start" />
                )}
                Add
              </Button>
            </form>
          </CardContent>
          <Separator />
          <ul className="-my-4 divide-y empty:hidden">
            <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
              {todos.map((todo) => (
                <motion.li
                  animate={{ height: "auto", opacity: 1 }}
                  className="hover:bg-muted/50 flex items-center gap-3 overflow-hidden px-4 py-3 transition-colors"
                  exit={
                    reduced
                      ? { opacity: 0 }
                      : { height: 0, opacity: 0, paddingBlock: 0 }
                  }
                  initial={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
                  layout="position"
                  transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}
                  key={todo.id}
                >
                  <Checkbox
                    aria-label={todo.title}
                    checked={todo.completed}
                    disabled={!hydrated}
                    onCheckedChange={(completed) => {
                      updateTodo.mutate({ completed, id: todo.id });
                    }}
                  />
                  <span
                    className={cn(
                      "flex-1 text-sm wrap-anywhere",
                      todo.completed &&
                        "text-muted-foreground decoration-muted-foreground/50 line-through"
                    )}
                  >
                    {todo.title}
                  </span>
                  <Button
                    aria-label={`Delete ${todo.title}`}
                    disabled={!hydrated}
                    onClick={() => {
                      deleteTodo.mutate({ id: todo.id });
                    }}
                    size="icon-sm"
                    variant="ghost"
                  >
                    <Trash2Icon className="text-muted-foreground" />
                  </Button>
                </motion.li>
              ))}
            </AnimatePresence>
          </ul>
          {todos.length === 0 && (
            <Empty>
              <EmptyHeader>
                <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
                  <ListTodoIcon />
                </EmptyMedia>
                <EmptyTitle>No todos yet.</EmptyTitle>
                <EmptyDescription>
                  Add one above. It is saved through the API to the database.
                </EmptyDescription>
              </EmptyHeader>
            </Empty>
          )}
        </Card>
      </section>
    </MotionConfig>
  );
};

export const Route = createFileRoute("/todos")({
  loader: async ({ context }) =>
    await context.queryClient.query(api.todos.list.queryOptions()),
  component: TodosPage,
});

import tailwindcss from "@tailwindcss/vite";
import { tanstackRouter } from "@tanstack/router-plugin/vite";
import react from "@vitejs/plugin-react";
import { defineConfig, loadEnv } from "vite-plus";

export default defineConfig(({ mode }) => {
  const { SERVER_URL = "http://localhost:3000" } = loadEnv(
    mode,
    import.meta.dirname,
    ""
  );

  return {
    plugins: [
      tanstackRouter({ target: "react", autoCodeSplitting: true }),
      react({ compiler: true }),
      tailwindcss(),
    ],
    server: {
      proxy: {
        "/api": SERVER_URL,
        "/rpc": SERVER_URL,
      },
    },
  };
});

import tailwindcss from "@tailwindcss/vite";
import { tanstackRouter } from "@tanstack/router-plugin/vite";
import react from "@vitejs/plugin-react";
import { defineConfig, loadEnv } from "vite-plus";

export default defineConfig(({ mode }) => {
  const { SERVER_URL = "http://localhost:3000" } = loadEnv(
    mode,
    import.meta.dirname,
    ""
  );

  return {
    plugins: [
      tanstackRouter({ target: "react", autoCodeSplitting: true }),
      react({ compiler: true }),
      tailwindcss(),
    ],
    server: {
      proxy: {
        "/api": SERVER_URL,
      },
    },
  };
});
